stock.description: Fusen Pharmaceutical Company Limited operates as an investment holding enterprise, primarily engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of a diverse range of pharmaceutical products across the People's Republic of China. Its extensive product portfolio includes specific cold remedies based on Shuanghuanglian, offered as both oral solutions and injections, alongside medications like flunarizine hydrochloride capsules and compound ferrous sulfate granules. The company further provides Yuanhu Zhitong oral solutions, Ganweikang tablets, and Yixinkang tablets. Beyond these, Fusen actively researches, develops, produces, and markets a variety of proprietary Chinese medicines and modern Western pharmaceuticals, targeting conditions such as colds, fevers, cardiovascular ailments, and anemia. Additionally, the firm offers business management and advisory services. Fusen Pharmaceutical Company Limited was established in 2003 and is headquartered in Nanyang, China.
